dialogues.jp: いつも通り、今日も巫女部へと足へ運ぶ。
dialogues.en: As usual, I headed to the Miko Club.
dialogues.text: As usual, I headed to the Miko Club.

dialogues.jp: 最近、放課後の日課になってるよな。
dialogues.en:
It's practically becoming a daily routine after school for
me.
dialogues.text:
It's practically becoming a daily routine after school for
me.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、環を待っていると、必然的にそうなるん
だけど。
dialogues.en: Since I have to wait for Tamaki though, it was inevitable.
dialogues.text: Since I have to wait for Tamaki though, it was inevitable.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、部員が増えてしまったため、今日も教
室で座学らしい。
dialogues.en:
With the ever-increasing membership, it looked like a real
class was about to be conducted.
dialogues.text:
With the ever-increasing membership, it looked like a real
class was about to be conducted.

dialogues.jp:
本格的な巫女の活動は、巫女装束を配ってから
だと、環が言っていた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had said that she would bring several Miko costumes,
to participate in Miko activities.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had said that she would bring several Miko costumes,
to participate in Miko activities.

dialogues.jp:
結局、先日の質問は、あのままうやむやになっ
てしまったらしい。
dialogues.en:
In the end, the question from the other day was left up in
the air.
dialogues.text:
In the end, the question from the other day was left up in
the air.

dialogues.jp:
一応、今日、それなりの返事をするそうだが、
おそらく通常の部員には、あまりうるさく言わ
ない形になるようだ。
dialogues.en:
Today looked like it was going to end up being another day
in the club.
dialogues.text:
Today looked like it was going to end up being another day
in the club.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、本当に純潔でなければ、巫女になれ
ないというのならば、なかなかなり手がいない
だろう。
dialogues.en:
Seemingly, it isn't impossible for those that aren't "pure"
to become a Miko...
dialogues.text:
Seemingly, it isn't impossible for those that aren't "pure"
to become a Miko...

dialogues.jp:
実際には、既婚者の巫女さんもいると聞いてい
るし、バイト募集の際に、そんなところを気に
する神社はないらしい。
dialogues.en:
I've heard of Miko being married, after all. And working
outside, and such...
dialogues.text:
I've heard of Miko being married, after all. And working
outside, and such...

dialogues.jp:
ただ……幼い頃から、巫女として神さまに仕え
てきた環にとっては、そんな簡単なことではな
いようだった。
dialogues.en:
But... for someone like Tamaki, raised on the Miko precepts,
it isn't that simple.
dialogues.text:
But... for someone like Tamaki, raised on the Miko precepts,
it isn't that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いつもすみません。いろいろと手伝ってもらっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, You always help me out..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, You always help me out..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいって。俺に遠慮することはないさ」
dialogues.en: "It's fine, you don't have to be so formal with me."
dialogues.text: "It's fine, you don't have to be so formal with me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それに……。最近、忙しくて一緒にいられな
　いし……」
dialogues.en:
"And... I've been so busy lately, we haven't had time
together..."
dialogues.text:
"And... I've been so busy lately, we haven't had time
together..."

dialogues.jp: 環は残念そうに言う。
dialogues.en: She spoke regretfully.
dialogues.text: She spoke regretfully.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、こうやって手伝っている間は一緒にい
　られるんだからさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, we're basically spending time together now, by myself
helping you out."
dialogues.text:
"Well, we're basically spending time together now, by myself
helping you out."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そう言って笑って見せたが、ゆっくり会
う時間はないせいか、環の顔にはほんの少し、
疲れが見えていた。
dialogues.en:
I tried to reassure her, but she seemed sad and tired
still... we haven't had much calm time together.
dialogues.text:
I tried to reassure her, but she seemed sad and tired
still... we haven't had much calm time together.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、巫女同好会も部に昇格し、部員も増え
て、傍目から見ても忙しそうだ。
dialogues.en:
The way that the Miko Club has been expanding, she's really
been busy lately.
dialogues.text:
The way that the Miko Club has been expanding, she's really
been busy lately.

dialogues.jp:
普通の部活ならともかく、巫女についての知識
があるのが環しかいないとなると、環が全て引
き受けなくてはならない。
dialogues.en:
Unlike a typical club, Tamaki is the only one with extensive
knowledge of Miko, so she has to be there always.
dialogues.text:
Unlike a typical club, Tamaki is the only one with extensive
knowledge of Miko, so she has to be there always.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……淋しいな」
dialogues.en: "...It's a bit lonesome."
dialogues.text: "...It's a bit lonesome."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 平気だ、と言ったらウソになる。
dialogues.en: If I said things were fine, I'd be lying.
dialogues.text: If I said things were fine, I'd be lying.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I'm terribly sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm terribly sorry..."

dialogues.jp: 俯き加減で環が言う。
dialogues.en: Her eyes were fixated on the floor.
dialogues.text: Her eyes were fixated on the floor.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なるべく環に負担を掛けないように、言
葉をかけてやる。
dialogues.en:
I quickly reassured her, wanting to ease her burden in any
way possible.
dialogues.text:
I quickly reassured her, wanting to ease her burden in any
way possible.

dialogues.jp:
「俺のことは、気にしなくていいよ。今は、大
　事なときだからさ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry about me so much. It's an important time for
you."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry about me so much. It's an important time for
you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「すみません」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、申し訳なさそうに俯いている。
dialogues.en: But she still wouldn't stop apologizing.
dialogues.text: But she still wouldn't stop apologizing.

dialogues.jp:
「そのうち、時間ができたら今の分、取り返す
　さ」
dialogues.en: "We'd make up for lost time soon enough."
dialogues.text: "We'd make up for lost time soon enough."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、そう言って、ニッと笑ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I smiled at her as I spoke.
dialogues.text: I smiled at her as I spoke.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、俺だって淋しいけど、今はそれくらい
しか言えなかった。
dialogues.en:
I was feeling lonely as well, but there was no way I'd let
her know.
dialogues.text:
I was feeling lonely as well, but there was no way I'd let
her know.

dialogues.jp:
でも──、実は環が何かを打ち込む姿を見るの
は、結構嬉しかったりする。
dialogues.en:
Besides, seeing her pour all her heart into this made me
happy too.
dialogues.text:
Besides, seeing her pour all her heart into this made me
happy too.

dialogues.jp: 素直に応援したくなるのだ。
dialogues.en: I honestly wanted to help her as much as I could.
dialogues.text: I honestly wanted to help her as much as I could.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺を見て嬉しそうな顔をして、
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me happily.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me happily.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Yes... thank you."
dialogues.text: "Yes... thank you."

dialogues.jp: と笑った。
dialogues.en: With a smile.
dialogues.text: With a smile.

dialogues.jp:
部室へ向かっている最中、巫女部の女の子が、
行を切らせながら、走ってきた。
dialogues.en:
About halfway to the clubroom, we saw one of the members
running around, out of breath.
dialogues.text:
About halfway to the clubroom, we saw one of the members
running around, out of breath.

dialogues.jp: そして、環を見つけると、急いで駆け寄る。
dialogues.en: She spotted Tamaki, then immediately ran to us.
dialogues.text: She spotted Tamaki, then immediately ran to us.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら？　どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "My, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "My, what's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp: 「ハァ、ハァ、部長。探してたんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Haah, haah... I was looking for you, chief!"
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah... I was looking for you, chief!"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp:
「実は、バスケ部のキャプテンが、部長に会い
　たいって……」
dialogues.en:
"The basketball club captain was here, saying he wanted to
meet you..."
dialogues.text:
"The basketball club captain was here, saying he wanted to
meet you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「必勝祈願かしら？」
dialogues.en: "For a victory prayer?"
dialogues.text: "For a victory prayer?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp: 「さ、さあ……用件までは……」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm not sure... he had some business with you..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm not sure... he had some business with you..."

dialogues.jp: 部員は、俺の方をチラチラ見ている。
dialogues.en: The club member took glances at me as he spoke.
dialogues.text: The club member took glances at me as he spoke.

dialogues.jp: 何だよ。
dialogues.en: What's up with her?
dialogues.text: What's up with her?

dialogues.jp: 俺がいたらまずいのか？
dialogues.en: Is it a bother for me to be around?
dialogues.text: Is it a bother for me to be around?

dialogues.jp: しかし、俺は構わず環に質問をする。
dialogues.en: I ignored her, and asked Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I ignored her, and asked Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 「最近、いろいろな部も成績がいいんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "All our clubs have been performing well recently, huh?"
dialogues.text: "All our clubs have been performing well recently, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
環が必勝祈願をした部が、次々に勝ち進んでい
るという噂は、杉並を通して聞いていた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami told me, the clubs that Tamaki performed victory
prayers for have been going on winning streaks.
dialogues.text:
Suginami told me, the clubs that Tamaki performed victory
prayers for have been going on winning streaks.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え、ええ……。偶然だと思うんですけど」
dialogues.en: "Y, yes... it is quite surprising.."
dialogues.text: "Y, yes... it is quite surprising.."

dialogues.jp: と、環は困った顔をする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki suddenly looked uneasy.
dialogues.text: Tamaki suddenly looked uneasy.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp:
「屋上で待ってるから、すぐ来て欲しい……と
　のことです」
dialogues.en:
"He's waiting at the rooftop, and said he wanted to meet you
as soon as possible..."
dialogues.text:
"He's waiting at the rooftop, and said he wanted to meet you
as soon as possible..."

dialogues.jp: と、部員は俺の方を見た。
dialogues.en: The club member glanced at me again.
dialogues.text: The club member glanced at me again.

dialogues.jp: え？　屋上？
dialogues.en: Huh? At the rooftop?
dialogues.text: Huh? At the rooftop?

dialogues.jp: 何で屋上なんだ？
dialogues.en: Why there, of all places?
dialogues.text: Why there, of all places?

dialogues.jp: 通常、必勝祈願は中庭か体育館裏でやっている。
dialogues.en:
All the victory prayers had been performed at the courtyard,
behind the gym.
dialogues.text:
All the victory prayers had been performed at the courtyard,
behind the gym.

dialogues.jp: 必勝祈願なら、屋上には呼び出さない。
dialogues.en:
If it's a victory prayer, there's no reason to call her up
to the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
If it's a victory prayer, there's no reason to call her up
to the rooftop.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、わたくし、ちょっと行ってきますか
　ら、朝倉様、先に行っていてください」
dialogues.en:
"I shall head there, then. Asakura-sama, please go on
ahead."
dialogues.text:
"I shall head there, then. Asakura-sama, please go on
ahead."

dialogues.jp: と、環は屋上に向かって歩き出した。
dialogues.en: Tamaki started walking towards the rooftop.
dialogues.text: Tamaki started walking towards the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: 何か、嫌な予感がする。
dialogues.en: I have a bad feeling about this.
dialogues.text: I have a bad feeling about this.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いけど、これ、教室持ってって」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, could you bring this to the classroom?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, could you bring this to the classroom?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp: 「え？　ちょ、ちょっと朝倉先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? W, wait, Asakura-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? W, wait, Asakura-senpai!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は部員にプリントの束を渡すと、環の後ろ姿
を追った。
dialogues.en:
I shoved the printouts at the club member, and chased after
Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
I shoved the printouts at the club member, and chased after
Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、音を立てないようにそっと、屋上の扉を
開ける。
dialogues.en: I quietly opened the doorway to the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I quietly opened the doorway to the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
｛まぶ／眩｝しい日の光が、一筋の線になって、俺の目に
入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I saw light on the other side, I peeked my head
through the door.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I saw light on the other side, I peeked my head
through the door.

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとして、この行動って、あまり男らしく
ないのかも……。
dialogues.en: This kind of behaviour isn't very fitting for a man...
dialogues.text: This kind of behaviour isn't very fitting for a man...

dialogues.jp: 覗き見する行為自体、既に負け犬みたいだ。
dialogues.en: I'm basically being a peeping tom here.
dialogues.text: I'm basically being a peeping tom here.

dialogues.jp: しかし、気になるものは気になる。
dialogues.en: But... whatever, I have my reasons.
dialogues.text: But... whatever, I have my reasons.

dialogues.jp: そう割り切って、屋上に目をやる。
dialogues.en: Hardening my resolve, I glanced around the rooftop.
dialogues.text: Hardening my resolve, I glanced around the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
目が光に慣れると、環と見たこともない男が話
をしている。
dialogues.en:
Once my eyes got used to the light, I saw Tamaki and an
unknown guy talking.
dialogues.text:
Once my eyes got used to the light, I saw Tamaki and an
unknown guy talking.

dialogues.jp:
男の顔は見えるが、環はこちらに背中を向けて
いる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki had her back to where I was, with the guy facing me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki had her back to where I was, with the guy facing me.

dialogues.jp:
あれは……確か、３年のバスケ部のキャプテン
だ。
dialogues.en:
That... appears to be the third-year Basketball Club
captain.
dialogues.text:
That... appears to be the third-year Basketball Club
captain.

dialogues.jp: 二人の会話が、風に乗って飛んでくる。
dialogues.en: A breeze blew by as they spoke.
dialogues.text: A breeze blew by as they spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp:
「すまないな、急に呼んだりして。あまりお話
　したこと、ないのに」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry for calling you up here so suddenly... I won't
take too much of your time."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry for calling you up here so suddenly... I won't
take too much of your time."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Y, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yes..."

dialogues.jp: 環の声は、明らかに戸惑っているのがわかる。
dialogues.en: There was unmistakable uncertainty in Tamaki's voice.
dialogues.text: There was unmistakable uncertainty in Tamaki's voice.

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp:
「それなのに、こんなことを言うのも、変に思
　われるかもしれませんが」
dialogues.en:
"And, please don't think anything weird of what I'm about to
ask."
dialogues.text:
"And, please don't think anything weird of what I'm about to
ask."

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「俺と付き合ってもらえないかな」
dialogues.en: "Will you go out with me?"
dialogues.text: "Will you go out with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ah?"
dialogues.text: "Ah?"

dialogues.jp: 環は戸惑い、思わずキャプテンに聞きかえす。
dialogues.en: The captain's request piled even more confusion onto Tamaki.
dialogues.text: The captain's request piled even more confusion onto Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
キャプテンは、必勝祈願などをお願いするため
に環を呼んだのではなく……。
dialogues.en:
The captain didn't call Tamaki here to ask for a victory
prayer...
dialogues.text:
The captain didn't call Tamaki here to ask for a victory
prayer...

dialogues.jp: そして、そのまま環は黙ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Tamaki fell silent.
dialogues.text: Tamaki fell silent.

dialogues.jp: ま、まさか、環に限って……。
dialogues.en: W, wait, does he mean...
dialogues.text: W, wait, does he mean...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、キャプテンの言葉をもう一度、冷静に繰
り返す。
dialogues.en: I tried to calmly repeat his words in my mind.
dialogues.text: I tried to calmly repeat his words in my mind.

dialogues.jp: オレト　ツキアッテ　モラエナイカナ
dialogues.en: "Will you go out with me?"
dialogues.text: "Will you go out with me?"

dialogues.jp: おいおいおいおいおい！
dialogues.en: Wait a second here!
dialogues.text: Wait a second here!

dialogues.jp: それはダメだろ。
dialogues.en: He can't ask that!
dialogues.text: He can't ask that!

dialogues.jp:
俺は思わず『ちょっとまったぁ〜』と、昔の
デート番組の台詞を吐きそうになる。
dialogues.en: I immediately thought of disrupting the scene.
dialogues.text: I immediately thought of disrupting the scene.

dialogues.jp: ここは、駆け寄って奪わないとダメだよな。
dialogues.en: I won't let him just come and steal her away.
dialogues.text: I won't let him just come and steal her away.

dialogues.jp: 男として。
dialogues.en: I'm a man too.
dialogues.text: I'm a man too.

dialogues.jp:
覗いていたのがばれてしまうが、背に腹はかえ
られぬ。
dialogues.en: If he wants a competition, I'm up to the challenge.
dialogues.text: If he wants a competition, I'm up to the challenge.

dialogues.jp: と、俺が屋上のドアを開けようとした時、
dialogues.en: But, as I was opening the door,
dialogues.text: But, as I was opening the door,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 環がキャプテンに頭を下げている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki bowed deeply to the captain.
dialogues.text: Tamaki bowed deeply to the captain.

dialogues.jp: 俺は出て行くタイミングを失い、様子を見守る。
dialogues.en:
Losing my timing for interrupting the scene, I shirked back
and continued watching.
dialogues.text:
Losing my timing for interrupting the scene, I shirked back
and continued watching.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくし、あなたとおつきあいはできません」
dialogues.en: "I cannot go out with you."
dialogues.text: "I cannot go out with you."

dialogues.jp:
怖いぐらいはっきりした口調で、環は告白を断っ
ている。
dialogues.en: Her tone was timid, but the rejection was clear.
dialogues.text: Her tone was timid, but the rejection was clear.

dialogues.jp: 俺は内心、ほっとする。
dialogues.en: I felt relieved down to my heart.
dialogues.text: I felt relieved down to my heart.

dialogues.jp: よかった。
dialogues.en: Thank goodness.
dialogues.text: Thank goodness.

dialogues.jp: そうだよな。環はきちんと断ってくれるよな。
dialogues.en: Of course... of course she would've refused him.
dialogues.text: Of course... of course she would've refused him.

dialogues.jp: 別に、疑ってた訳じゃないんだけど……。
dialogues.en: It's not that I doubted her or anything...
dialogues.text: It's not that I doubted her or anything...

dialogues.jp:
いざ、こういう場面に直面すると、やはりうろ
たえてしまう。
dialogues.en: But the scene and the act might've flustered her.
dialogues.text: But the scene and the act might've flustered her.

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「他に、誰か好きな人でもいるのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Does that mean you have someone else you like?"
dialogues.text: "Does that mean you have someone else you like?"

dialogues.jp: キャプテンも、納得できないのだろう。
dialogues.en: The captain didn't seem to be able to accept it.
dialogues.text: The captain didn't seem to be able to accept it.

dialogues.jp: 見た感じ、いい男だし。
dialogues.en: Just looking at him, he seemed like a good guy.
dialogues.text: Just looking at him, he seemed like a good guy.

dialogues.jp: 振られた経験なさそうだよな。
dialogues.en: Seems like he's gone through this before too.
dialogues.text: Seems like he's gone through this before too.

dialogues.jp: 悪いけど、俺と環は付き合ってるから……。
dialogues.en: Sorry, but Tamaki and I are dating...
dialogues.text: Sorry, but Tamaki and I are dating...

dialogues.jp: と、俺は鼻の穴を大きくして何となく勝ち誇る。
dialogues.en: The whole situation made me feel a sense of triumph somehow.
dialogues.text: The whole situation made me feel a sense of triumph somehow.

dialogues.jp: 環の『はい』という返事を信じて……。
dialogues.en: I waited her affirmative reply with bated breath.
dialogues.text: I waited her affirmative reply with bated breath.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
dialogues.en: "That's..."
dialogues.text: "That's..."

dialogues.jp: 環が口を開いた瞬間、
dialogues.en: As she opened her mouth to reply,
dialogues.text: As she opened her mouth to reply,

dialogues.jp:
不意に頭を押さえて、その場にどさりと倒れ込
んでしまった。
dialogues.en:
Her head fell suddenly, and the rest of her body followed as
she collapsed.
dialogues.text:
Her head fell suddenly, and the rest of her body followed as
she collapsed.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はバタンとドアを開け、環の元へ駆け寄る。
dialogues.en: I crashed the door open, and dashed over to Tamaki's side.
dialogues.text: I crashed the door open, and dashed over to Tamaki's side.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you okay?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環をゆっくりと抱き起こす。
dialogues.en: I slowly took her fallen body into my arms.
dialogues.text: I slowly took her fallen body into my arms.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環の顔はみるみるうちに、血の気が引いていく。
dialogues.en:
Looking at Tamaki this way was starting to make me
embarassed.
dialogues.text:
Looking at Tamaki this way was starting to make me
embarassed.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "Are you alright?"

dialogues.jp:
返事ではそう言いながらも、表情を見ると辛そ
うだ。
dialogues.en: That was her answer, but her face told a different story.
dialogues.text: That was her answer, but her face told a different story.

dialogues.jp:
「よし、すぐ保健室へ行こう！　俺が連れてっ
　てやるから！」
dialogues.en:
"At any rate, you should see the doctor! I'd bring you to
the infirmary!"
dialogues.text:
"At any rate, you should see the doctor! I'd bring you to
the infirmary!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環に肩を貸し、支えてやる。
dialogues.en: I helped her up, and gave her my shoulder to lean on.
dialogues.text: I helped her up, and gave her my shoulder to lean on.

dialogues.jp:
キャプテンは、突然の俺の登場に驚いたのか、
何も言わない。
dialogues.en:
The captain was taken aback at my sudden appearance, but
said nothing.
dialogues.text:
The captain was taken aback at my sudden appearance, but
said nothing.

dialogues.jp: 環はキャプテンの方へ振り向き、
dialogues.en: Tamaki unsteadily turned to the captain one last time,
dialogues.text: Tamaki unsteadily turned to the captain one last time,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm really sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm really sorry."

dialogues.jp: と、小さな声で言った。
dialogues.en: And whispered her final words to him.
dialogues.text: And whispered her final words to him.

dialogues.jp: 環を支え、ゆっくりと階段を下りる。
dialogues.en:
Making sure Tamaki was supported well, we walked carefully
down the stairs.
dialogues.text:
Making sure Tamaki was supported well, we walked carefully
down the stairs.

dialogues.jp:
環の身体は、全く力が入らないように、ぐった
りとしている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's body seemed devoid of any sort of energy
whatsoever.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's body seemed devoid of any sort of energy
whatsoever.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you're okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you're okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……はい。今までは、こんなことなかったの
　ですが……」
dialogues.en: "...Yes. I've just never felt this way before..."
dialogues.text: "...Yes. I've just never felt this way before..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女部には俺から伝えておくから、とにかく
　保健室で休め」
dialogues.en:
"Let me handle the Miko Club matters for today. You should
get a good rest at the infirmary."
dialogues.text:
"Let me handle the Miko Club matters for today. You should
get a good rest at the infirmary."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「後で迎えに行くから」
dialogues.en: "I'd pick you up later."
dialogues.text: "I'd pick you up later."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Alright..."
dialogues.text: "Alright..."

dialogues.jp:
部員達の待つ教室へ戻ると、さっきの話がもう
噂になっていた。
dialogues.en: I quickly brought Tamaki to the infirmary.
dialogues.text: I quickly brought Tamaki to the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
保健室に行く前、最初にここに来たバスケ部員
にぶつかりそうになったのを思い出した。
dialogues.en:
I then returned to the classroom, where the news about the
scene already spread to the club members.
dialogues.text:
I then returned to the classroom, where the news about the
scene already spread to the club members.

dialogues.jp:
お節介なのか、口が軽いのかわからない後輩が
喋ったに違いない。
dialogues.en: No doubt, the loose mouth of that underclassman at work.
dialogues.text: No doubt, the loose mouth of that underclassman at work.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「聞いた？　胡ノ宮先輩、バスケ部のキャプテ
　ンの告白、断ったんだって」
dialogues.en:
"Did you hear? Konomiya-sempai rejected the Basketball Club
captain's confession!"
dialogues.text:
"Did you hear? Konomiya-sempai rejected the Basketball Club
captain's confession!"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「えーっ、そうなの？　あたしだったら、そっ
　こーでＯＫしちゃうけど……」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh, really? If it were me, I'd definitely say yes..."
dialogues.text: "Ehhh, really? If it were me, I'd definitely say yes..."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 3
dialogues.jp:
「バスケ部のキャプテンって、なにげに人気あ
　るよね。なんで断ったんだろ」
dialogues.en:
"The Basketball Club captain is really popular too. Why did
she reject him?"
dialogues.text:
"The Basketball Club captain is really popular too. Why did
she reject him?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、アレじゃないの？　巫女は純潔でなきゃ
　いけないっていう……」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't it what she spoke of before? That Miko have to
maintain their purity..."
dialogues.text:
"Isn't it what she spoke of before? That Miko have to
maintain their purity..."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 3
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり？　巫女って、大変よねー」
dialogues.en: "You think? Miko must live a hard life..."
dialogues.text: "You think? Miko must live a hard life..."

dialogues.jp: まったく、彼女たちと来たら……。
dialogues.en: Sheesh, these chatterboxes...
dialogues.text: Sheesh, these chatterboxes...

dialogues.jp:
別に環は、巫女だからって理由で断ったんじゃ
ないんだぞ。と、言ってやりたい。
dialogues.en:
I want to tell them, it's not because she's a Miko that she
rejected him...
dialogues.text:
I want to tell them, it's not because she's a Miko that she
rejected him...

dialogues.jp:
環は俺のことが好きだから断ったのであって
……。
dialogues.en: It's because she likes me...
dialogues.text: It's because she likes me...

dialogues.jp:
ん、待てよ。俺はこの部で、環の彼氏として認
識されてないってことだよな。
dialogues.en:
...Then again, it appears none of the club knows that I'm
Tamaki's boyfriend.
dialogues.text:
...Then again, it appears none of the club knows that I'm
Tamaki's boyfriend.

dialogues.jp: まあ、はっきり言ってなかったしな。
dialogues.en: I'd just let things settle down by themselves.
dialogues.text: I'd just let things settle down by themselves.

dialogues.jp:
環にとっては、『恋人がいる』って知られるこ
とがマイナスに働くのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
If people found out Tamaki had a boyfriend, it might affect
the people's perception of her.
dialogues.text:
If people found out Tamaki had a boyfriend, it might affect
the people's perception of her.

dialogues.jp: 特に、巫女部においてはそうだ。
dialogues.en: Especially those in the Miko club.
dialogues.text: Especially those in the Miko club.

dialogues.jp: ここは、黙っておく方がよさそうだ。
dialogues.en: It's probably best for me to stay quiet.
dialogues.text: It's probably best for me to stay quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、巫女サンは恋愛をしちゃいけない
　のよ」
dialogues.en: "Miko really can't fall in love, huh."
dialogues.text: "Miko really can't fall in love, huh."

dialogues.jp: その部員の言葉が、俺の心に重くのしかかった。
dialogues.en: The club member's words struck deep into my heart.
dialogues.text: The club member's words struck deep into my heart.

dialogues.jp: 俺は環を保健室へ迎えに行き、一緒に帰る。
dialogues.en:
I picked up Tamaki at the infirmary again, and we went home
together.
dialogues.text:
I picked up Tamaki at the infirmary again, and we went home
together.

dialogues.jp: 「どうだ？　まだ頭痛するのか？」
dialogues.en: "How are you? Do you still have headaches?"
dialogues.text: "How are you? Do you still have headaches?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。まだ少し……でも、大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "Yes, a little... but it's fine."
dialogues.text: "Yes, a little... but it's fine."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はご迷惑をおかけしました」
dialogues.en: "I've been so much trouble today."
dialogues.text: "I've been so much trouble today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様が助けてくれなかったら、わたくし
　……」
dialogues.en: "If you didn't come to save me, I would have..."
dialogues.text: "If you didn't come to save me, I would have..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「何言ってんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What are you saying..."
dialogues.text: "What are you saying..."

dialogues.jp: 当然だろ？
dialogues.en: It's natural, isn't it?
dialogues.text: It's natural, isn't it?

dialogues.jp: と、言ってやりたいが言葉を飲み込む。
dialogues.en:
That's what I wanted to say, but on second thoughts, I
gulped it down.
dialogues.text:
That's what I wanted to say, but on second thoughts, I
gulped it down.

dialogues.jp:
それに、あんなおいしい役を、新参者のキャプ
テンに取られてたまるか。
dialogues.en: I'm sure that newcomer captain would've helped her out too.
dialogues.text: I'm sure that newcomer captain would've helped her out too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女部の人たちにも、悪いことをしてしまい
　ましたね」
dialogues.en: "I've neglected the members of the Miko Club as well..."
dialogues.text: "I've neglected the members of the Miko Club as well..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「みなさん、怒ってませんでした？」
dialogues.en: "Are they angry?"
dialogues.text: "Are they angry?"

dialogues.jp: 環は心配そうに俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki enquired of me worryingly.
dialogues.text: Tamaki enquired of me worryingly.

dialogues.jp:
自分の身体が大変なときでも、やっぱり気にな
るんだな。
dialogues.en:
Even when her body's like this, she's still worrying about
things like that...
dialogues.text:
Even when her body's like this, she's still worrying about
things like that...

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、頑張りすぎだとは思うけど。
dialogues.en: I think she's working too hard for this,
dialogues.text: I think she's working too hard for this,

dialogues.jp: そこが、環のいいところなのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: But that's possibly one of her good points.
dialogues.text: But that's possibly one of her good points.

dialogues.jp: 「うん。大丈夫だったよ」
dialogues.en: "Nah, they were fine."
dialogues.text: "Nah, they were fine."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、『巫女は恋をしてはいけないんだ』と
部員が思っているようだ、ということは伏せて
おく。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't let her know that the club now thought that Miko
cannot fall in love.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't let her know that the club now thought that Miko
cannot fall in love.

dialogues.jp: 言ったところで、また環を苦しめるだけだ。
dialogues.en: If she found out, she'd surely be anguished again.
dialogues.text: If she found out, she'd surely be anguished again.

dialogues.jp:
時々、このまま答えなんて、出さなくてもいい
かなって思うときがある。
dialogues.en: At times like this, it's better to hide the truth.
dialogues.text: At times like this, it's better to hide the truth.

dialogues.jp: 今の関係が、壊れてしまうのが、怖い。
dialogues.en: I'm... scared of losing what we have now.
dialogues.text: I'm... scared of losing what we have now.

dialogues.jp: ずっと、一緒にいたい。
dialogues.en: I want to be with her, forever.
dialogues.text: I want to be with her, forever.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ダメですね、わたくし……」
dialogues.en: "I'm a horrible person..."
dialogues.text: "I'm a horrible person..."

dialogues.jp:
一瞬何のことかわからなかったが、すぐに思い
当たる節を思い出す。
dialogues.en: What she said was confusing, but I then remembered.
dialogues.text: What she said was confusing, but I then remembered.

dialogues.jp:
礼節を重んじる環のことだ……。バスケ部のキャ
プテンにちゃんと返答できなかったことを悔や
んでいるんだろう。
dialogues.en:
She couldn't answer the Basketball Club captain the way he
wanted... for the ultra-polite Tamaki...
dialogues.text:
She couldn't answer the Basketball Club captain the way he
wanted... for the ultra-polite Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、もったいないとか、思わなかった
　のか？　あの先輩、結構人気あるらしいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"That sempai seems to be really popular... you never thought
of accepting?"
dialogues.text:
"That sempai seems to be really popular... you never thought
of accepting?"

dialogues.jp: 否定してくれると信じながら、俺は環に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Believing that she'd answer negatively, I asked her.
dialogues.text: Believing that she'd answer negatively, I asked her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「全然」
dialogues.en: "Not at all."
dialogues.text: "Not at all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そっか」
よかった。
dialogues.en: That's... good.
dialogues.text: That's... good.

dialogues.jp: ほっとした。
dialogues.en: It makes me breathe easier, at least.
dialogues.text: It makes me breathe easier, at least.

dialogues.jp:
女子部員の話だと、告白を断るのが悪みたいな
言い方だったもんな。
dialogues.en:
The way those girls were talking, it was as if rejecting
that confession was a sin.
dialogues.text:
The way those girls were talking, it was as if rejecting
that confession was a sin.

dialogues.jp:
だから、本当はちょっと、惜しいなとか思って
たんじゃないかと疑っていた。
dialogues.en:
But for her, I shouldn't... didn't doubt that there was
nothing regrettable for her.
dialogues.text:
But for her, I shouldn't... didn't doubt that there was
nothing regrettable for her.

dialogues.jp: そこで、そのまま、二人とも黙ってしまった。
dialogues.en: After that short exchange, silence fell upon us.
dialogues.text: After that short exchange, silence fell upon us.

dialogues.jp: 何か今日は、色々なことがあった。
dialogues.en: Lots of things happened today.
dialogues.text: Lots of things happened today.

dialogues.jp: そのせいか、なんだかお互いぎこちない。
dialogues.en: We were both still disoriented from it all.
dialogues.text: We were both still disoriented from it all.

dialogues.jp: 何を話せばいいんだろう……。
dialogues.en: What should I say here to break this uneasy silence...
dialogues.text: What should I say here to break this uneasy silence...

dialogues.jp: と、俺が悩んでいると、環が俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
Before I could think of anything good, Tamaki looked towards
me.
dialogues.text:
Before I could think of anything good, Tamaki looked towards
me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "...Yeah?"

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺の腰に手をまわして、抱えるようにす
る。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki wrapped her hands around my waist, and hugged me
tightly.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki wrapped her hands around my waist, and hugged me
tightly.

dialogues.en: "...Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 俺の心臓は、またドキドキし始めた。
dialogues.en: My heart started to beat furiously.
dialogues.text: My heart started to beat furiously.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "I love you..."
dialogues.text: "I love you..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず聞き返す。
dialogues.en: Still embracing me, she whispered.
dialogues.text: Still embracing me, she whispered.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...I love you."
dialogues.text: "...I love you."

dialogues.jp: ……ようやく。
dialogues.en:
She then looked me straight in the eyes, and repeated
herself.
dialogues.text:
She then looked me straight in the eyes, and repeated
herself.

dialogues.jp: 環の口から聞けた言葉……。
dialogues.en: I gently brushed through her hair with my fingers.
dialogues.text: I gently brushed through her hair with my fingers.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、待っていたのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: "I love you too..."
dialogues.text: "I love you too..."

dialogues.jp: ……あの日からずっと。
dialogues.en:
Feeling her soft strands of hair fall between my fingers
made me feel at ease.
dialogues.text:
Feeling her soft strands of hair fall between my fingers
made me feel at ease.

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の頭をなでてやる。
dialogues.en: We stayed there for a while, hugging.
dialogues.text: We stayed there for a while, hugging.

dialogues.jp: 「俺もだよ……」
dialogues.en: Now... for this time and our love...
dialogues.text: Now... for this time and our love...

dialogues.jp:
環の髪の毛を触りながら、俺も満ち足りた気持
ちになる。
dialogues.en: I'd protect her from anything and everything...
dialogues.text: I'd protect her from anything and everything...

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、そのまま抱きしめあう。
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, do you want to visit my house today?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, do you want to visit my house today?"

dialogues.jp: 今……この時間を愛しむように……。
dialogues.en:
Of course, considering how we were now, the hidden meaning
of that was obvious.
dialogues.text:
Of course, considering how we were now, the hidden meaning
of that was obvious.

dialogues.jp: 全てのものから、環を守るように……。
dialogues.en:
But in the end, she shook her head no, turning her face away
from me.
dialogues.text:
But in the end, she shook her head no, turning her face away
from me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You're... what?"
dialogues.text: "You're... what?"

dialogues.jp: 環が、何かに悩んでいるのが伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was trying to tell me something...
dialogues.text: Tamaki was trying to tell me something...

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の腕の中でつぶやく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki mumbled into my arms,
dialogues.text: Tamaki mumbled into my arms,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「怖いんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm scared..."
dialogues.text: "I'm scared..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は一瞬、環の言葉に耳を疑う。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's answer left me not believing my ears.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's answer left me not believing my ears.

dialogues.jp: 環は、ゆっくり不安をかみ締めるように言う。
dialogues.en: She finally started to spill out all her uneasiness.
dialogues.text: She finally started to spill out all her uneasiness.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしは……。本当は恋をしてはいけない
　のでしょうか……」
dialogues.en: "Since... I really can't fall in love..."
dialogues.text: "Since... I really can't fall in love..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず動揺する。
dialogues.en: I started to tremble uncontrollably.
dialogues.text: I started to tremble uncontrollably.

dialogues.jp:
それは、二人は一緒にいられないって意味なの
だろうか？
dialogues.en: She means... that we can't be together?
dialogues.text: She means... that we can't be together?

dialogues.jp:
今までは考えたことがなかった、『別れ』とい
う言葉が一瞬よぎる。
dialogues.en:
I hadn't even thought about seperating... or maybe, I didn't
want to.
dialogues.text:
I hadn't even thought about seperating... or maybe, I didn't
want to.

dialogues.jp: 結論を、出さなければならないのか……？
dialogues.en: In the end, we can't do anything about it...?
dialogues.text: In the end, we can't do anything about it...?

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、あのことが……」
dialogues.en: "So it was about that..."
dialogues.text: "So it was about that..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なるべく核心に触れないように、遠まわ
しに尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I trailed off, not really wanting to approach the subject.
dialogues.text: I trailed off, not really wanting to approach the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいえ……」
環は俺の身体に、顔を埋める。
dialogues.en: She buried her face into my arms again.
dialogues.text: She buried her face into my arms again.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、わたくしって、ずるいですよね」
dialogues.en: "And... I'm a bad person."
dialogues.text: "And... I'm a bad person."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ずるい？」
dialogues.en: "A bad person?"
dialogues.text: "A bad person?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の問いかけに、環は顔を上げた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked up at me as I questioned.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked up at me as I questioned.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺を見つめていった。
dialogues.en: And her eyes fixed their gaze onto my face.
dialogues.text: And her eyes fixed their gaze onto my face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女は……恋してはいけないんですか？
　……って聞かれたとき」
dialogues.en:
"Miko... aren't supposed to fall in love... when I heard
that question..."
dialogues.text:
"Miko... aren't supposed to fall in love... when I heard
that question..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくし、きちんと答えることができなかっ
　た」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't answer it at all."
dialogues.text: "I couldn't answer it at all."

dialogues.jp: そのことか。
dialogues.en: About that...
dialogues.text: About that...

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、環も悩んでいたんだ。
dialogues.en: She was really thinking about that, after all...
dialogues.text: She was really thinking about that, after all...

dialogues.jp: 俺だって悩むんだから、当たり前だな。
dialogues.en: Of course, I was too.
dialogues.text: Of course, I was too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……あなたと一緒にいることを、否定するこ
　とになってしまうから……」
dialogues.en:
"...I could not just deny being with you, and what we
had..."
dialogues.text:
"...I could not just deny being with you, and what we
had..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、伏目がちに語る。
dialogues.en: At this kind of time...
dialogues.text: At this kind of time...

dialogues.jp: こんなとき。
dialogues.en: What would those people in those romance novels say.
dialogues.text: What would those people in those romance novels say.

dialogues.jp: 恋愛のうまいヤツラは、何て答えるんだろう。
dialogues.en: Should I tell her that that's not neccessarily the case?
dialogues.text: Should I tell her that that's not neccessarily the case?

dialogues.jp: そんなことないって、否定するんだろうか。
dialogues.en: Should I thank her?
dialogues.text: Should I thank her?

dialogues.jp: それとも、ありがとうって言うんだろうか。
dialogues.en: Or should I tell her everything else I want to tell her...
dialogues.text: Or should I tell her everything else I want to tell her...

dialogues.jp: もっと、別の言葉をかけるのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Anything I could say now would seem out of place.
dialogues.text: Anything I could say now would seem out of place.

dialogues.jp: こんなとき、言葉は意地悪になる。
dialogues.en:
The feelings I wanted to communicate to her, couldn't reach
her.
dialogues.text:
The feelings I wanted to communicate to her, couldn't reach
her.

dialogues.jp:
何かを伝えたいという気持ちがあっても、何も
伝えられない。
dialogues.en: The words wouldn't come out of my mouth.
dialogues.text: The words wouldn't come out of my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 言葉にならない……。
dialogues.en:
Even just holding each other and feeling our hearts beat in
tandem, felt out of place.
dialogues.text:
Even just holding each other and feeling our hearts beat in
tandem, felt out of place.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、抱き合って、お互いの鼓動を聞くことし
かできない。
dialogues.en: I didn't know anything I could say to ease her worries.
dialogues.text: I didn't know anything I could say to ease her worries.

dialogues.jp:
環にとって、なんて言ってあげるのがいいのか、
俺にはわからなかった。
dialogues.en:
"Let's just be together"... although that seems so normal, I
couldn't stop my hesitation.
dialogues.text:
"Let's just be together"... although that seems so normal, I
couldn't stop my hesitation.

dialogues.jp:
『一緒にいてやるよ』って、いつも言ってる言
葉さえ｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝してしまう。
dialogues.en:
I can't say that, without knowing the real meaning or proof
of being together, or so I thought.
dialogues.text:
I can't say that, without knowing the real meaning or proof
of being together, or so I thought.

dialogues.jp: 俺も、やっぱりずるい。
dialogues.en: I'm a bad person too...
dialogues.text: I'm a bad person too...

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、神社へ続く公園の通り道で、しばらく
二人で抱き合っていた。
dialogues.en:
We continued on to the shrine, still holding each other
tightly.
dialogues.text:
We continued on to the shrine, still holding each other
tightly.

dialogues.jp: ◆巫女は恋愛できない？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miko Can't Love??◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miko Can't Love??◆

dialogues.jp: 環が、バスケ部のキャプテンに呼び出された。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was called out by the Basketball Club captain.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was called out by the Basketball Club captain.

dialogues.jp:
こっそり後をつけると、どうやらキャプテンの
告白のようだった。
dialogues.en:
I followed after her, and spied on a love confession from
the captain.
dialogues.text:
I followed after her, and spied on a love confession from
the captain.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、環は断ったのだが、理由を話そうと
した瞬間、突然頭痛で倒れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Of course, she rejected him, but as she was about to
explain, a sudden headache made her collapse.
dialogues.text:
Of course, she rejected him, but as she was about to
explain, a sudden headache made her collapse.

dialogues.jp:
巫女部に戻ると、環が告白を断ったことで持ち
きりだった。
dialogues.en:
By the time I got back to the Miko Club, the news of the
rejection had already spread like wildfire.
dialogues.text:
By the time I got back to the Miko Club, the news of the
rejection had already spread like wildfire.

dialogues.jp:
巫女は、恋愛をしてはいけない、という認識が
部員の中に埋め込まれてしまったらしい。
dialogues.en:
The club members eventually settled on the assumption that
Miko cannot fall in love.
dialogues.text:
The club members eventually settled on the assumption that
Miko cannot fall in love.

dialogues.jp:
その帰り、環は不安なのだという。今、この瞬
間がとても幸せで、もしそれが壊れてしまった
らと考えると、とても不安になるらしい。
dialogues.en:
On the way back, Tamaki was uneasy. Uncertain whether this
blessed time would be destroyed.
dialogues.text:
On the way back, Tamaki was uneasy. Uncertain whether this
blessed time would be destroyed.

dialogues.jp: そして、巫女部員達に自分が話したこと……。
dialogues.en: And with what she should tell the Miko Club members.
dialogues.text: And with what she should tell the Miko Club members.

dialogues.jp:
自分の想い自体を否定しかねないことに、環は
葛藤していた。
dialogues.en:
Having to deny her own feelings, Tamaki was truly
conflicted.
dialogues.text:
Having to deny her own feelings, Tamaki was truly
conflicted.
